liffraedi-extended.label: Líffræði + aðliggjandi orðasöfn (Biology + adjacent subjects)
liffraedi-extended._note: For OpenStax Biology 2e, whose scope spans genetics, immunology, ecology and taxonomy. Counts verified 2026-07-26 from https://idord.arnastofnun.is/d/api/es/agg/dictionaries/ (82 collections total; the full list with names is at /d/api/dictionaries/?limit=1000). IMPORTANT: collections disagree with each other — 70 of 217 headwords shared by LIFORD and ERFDAFR (32%) have different Icelandic. Keep fkdictionary with every imported term and resolve precedence per domain; do NOT union them blindly.

collections.label: Erfðafræði / genetics (1,163) — uses RNA/DNA, not RKS/DKS

_deliberately_excluded.LAEKN: Læknisfræði / medicine — 33,593 terms. Relevant to the anatomy/physiology chapters but needs per-letter fetching (ES 10k cap) and would dominate any merge. Add deliberately, not by default.
_deliberately_excluded.FLORA: Plöntuheiti / plant names — 11,532. Species names, not concept terminology.
_deliberately_excluded.LYFJAFRLYFJASTOFNUN: Lyfjafræði / pharmacology — 943. Add if the book covers pharmacology.
